notes.title: !!!ATTENTION!!! Release date is moved.
notes.content:
!!!ATTENTION!!!

We have some bad news,which are actually fine. We received a letter from the Kool Kids Klan to delay our game until the end of semester. So the release date is moved to the 4th of march. Or something... dont know... we dont really learn numbers here in Motherland.

We have to fix some minor errors, that were found by the beta-testers like cars rolling over and Putin killing you instead of everyone else.

Thanks for your interest in the project. Hit ASS up on youtube or email if you have something to say.
